source.quote: FiiO's own parameters page, read 2026-11-24. « Hardware solution »: « Main control: X2000; MCU: ESP32-S3; DAC: AK4497S*2; USB decoding: XU316; Bluetooth decoding: QCC5125; AMP: MJE243G/253G discrete transistor current amplification ». « Max. supported sampling rate » rows: « USB decoding: Up to 768kHz/32bit; DSD512 (Native) »; « Coaxial input decoding: Up to 192kHz/24bit; DSD64 »; « Optical input decoding: Up to 96kHz/24bit »; « Streaming decoding: Up to 384kHz/32bit; DSD256 (DOP) »; « Local playback: Up to 384kHz/32bit; DSD256 ». The rate block is headed « Max. supported sampling rate (PEQ=OFF) ». Another row reads « Supports 10-band PEQ (No PEQ processing in line input and balanced input) ». No digital filter, oversampling or NOS row; nothing about R2R, ladder or delta-sigma.

facts.chip: Two AK4497S (AKM), XMOS XU316 as USB receiver, QCC5125 for Bluetooth.

_les_plafonds_sont_donnes_PEQ_eteint: The rate rows are headed « Max. supported sampling rate (PEQ=OFF) ». The ceilings are therefore stated for a device whose parametric equaliser is OFF, and the maker says elsewhere on its own pages that PEQ is not applied to every path. This catalogue has no way to attach a CONDITION to a ceiling: pcm_max_hz is one number. Recorded because a user running PEQ may not get these figures, and the page is honest enough to say so in its own heading.
_deux_lignes_notees_et_sans_cle: « Streaming decoding » and « Local playback » are rated as precisely as USB and are not written. The first is a network input the protocol-level interface vocabulary has no name for - seventh occurrence in this harvest - and the second is not an input at all but the device reading its own storage, which this catalogue does not model.
